comment: Notify OSHA within 8 hours of a fatality, and within 24 hours of an in-patient hospitalization, amputation, or loss of an eye. If governed by a state OSH program, notify your state first.
Report releases of hazardous chemicals dispersed off-site. A written report must follow to all notified agencies within 14 calendar days.
OSI Product Recall Loss Reporting: notify the Corporate CIMT Risk Management member within 48 hours; if unavailable after 8 hours, call this line.
Notify CISA within 72 hours of a covered cyber incident and within 24 hours of any ransomware payment.
